description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableJsonInt, a specialized representation of a JSON number that fits within a Java int type. It extends AbstractJsonNumber and provides methods for instance creation, equality checking, hashing, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonInt
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON number that fits in an int, providing methods to create instances and handle JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableJsonInt instance with the specified int value.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Indicates that this number is an int.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Indicates that this number also fits into a long.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on value and type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the int value.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the number to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Provides an upper bound estimate for the string size when serialized.
